question: Should maintainers accept Recharts 3.9.2 after package-content review, and should this PR be narrowed so the separate `react-hook-form` and `react-resizable-panels` PRs remain independent?
rationale: The dependency package metadata changed in a supply-chain-relevant way, and automation should not decide whether unrelated direct dependency bumps may be bundled into this Recharts PR.

options.title: Narrow and review before merge
options.body: Remove the unrelated direct dependency changes, inspect the Recharts 3.9.2 package contents and metadata, then merge only after CI and preview cover the narrowed lockfile.

options.title: Accept the broad lockfile update
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally land the included `react-hook-form` and `react-resizable-panels` updates here, but that effectively supersedes their separate PR review paths.

options.title: Pause or recreate
options.body: Close or recreate this PR if Dependabot cannot keep the Recharts bump independent from the other open dependency updates.

recommendation.title: Narrow and review before merge
recommendation.body: Remove the unrelated direct dependency changes, inspect the Recharts 3.9.2 package contents and metadata, then merge only after CI and preview cover the narrowed lockfile.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the only high-confidence repository-history owner for dependency policy and recent lockfile refreshes.
